chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abi al-Sabbah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot the adhan until he had prayed. He said: “He does not repeat.”

key_terms.لَا يُعِيدُ: he does not repeat the prayer
key_terms.ٱلْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer given before salat

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets the adhan and prays, must he repeat the salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the adhan and only remembers after completing the salat. The Imam عليه السلام states that such a person does not need to repeat the prayer, indicating that omission of the adhan out of forgetfulness does not invalidate it.
